== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[madra|Madra]] Engine is a highly valuable [[Divine Treasure]] composed of brass and [[steel]]. This mechanical device functions through the movement of pistons that hiss and vent [[madra]] essence at regular intervals, utilizing [[dead matter]] of a pure variety. It serves as a powerful tool for recovery, capable of replenishing a user's [[madra]] to sustain prolonged combat. Additionally, the engine can be powered by specific items, such as certain fruits, which could theoretically grant an [[Underlord]] the longevity of an [[Archlord]] or allow the device to operate without causing harm to the user.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[madra|Madra]] Engine is a [[Divine Treasure]] composed of [[dead matter]] consisting of [[pure madra]] and shaped like a blue crystal nest of tubes. [[Charity]] sunk this [[construct]] into [[Yerin]]'s midsection, where it settled into the center of her [[madra channels]] to surround and contain her core. This device functions by converting life and [[blood essence]] into [[madra]] at an accelerated rate. Through this process, the engine successfully recovered [[Yerin]]'s [[madra]] and continues to restore it whenever she breathes.}}
